events.verdict: Gobert (MIN) establishes screening position in Murray's (SAC) path and marginal contact occurs to his side as the pick is set.
Edwards (MIN) is moving alongside Murray's (SAC) path and marginal body contact occurs as they come together in transition.
Sabonis (SAC) establishes a legal position in McDaniles' (MIN) path and marginal contact occurs as he seals him off after the pass.
Fox (SAC) reaches around and makes marginal contact to Edwards' (MIN) arm while defending the early pick in the offense.
Lyles (SAC) steps into Edwards' (MIN) path and initiates body contact that affects the follow-through of his driving shot attempt.
Gobert (MIN) establishes screening position in Huerter's (SAC) path and marginal contact occurs to his side as the pick is set. As Gobert rolls to the basket, Huerter briefly restricts his movement.
Murray (SAC) swipes down and initiates contact with Edwards' (MIN) arm, which affects his SQBR during his driving shot attempt.
Ellis (SAC) legally contests Conley's (MIN) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Following the long rebound, Randle (MIN) steps to, not through Ellis' (SAC) position and marginal body contact occurs as they come together during Ellis' attempt to pass.

events.verdict: Ellis (SAC) touches the ball last before going out of bounds.
Fox (SAC) avoids making any contact with McDaniels (MIN) as he legally contests his jump shot attempt.
Randle (MIN) goes to, not through, Lyles' (SAC) space and marginal body contact occurs as the two come together during the driving shot attempt.
Sabonis (SAC) and McDaniels (MIN) come together at the end of the pick and make mutual marginal contact as they attempt to disengage.

Replay review of the foul called on McDaniels (MIN) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. McDaniels (MIN) clamps and holds Sabonis' (SAC) arm, which affects his ability to pursue the rebound.
Lyles (SAC) moves alongside Randle's (MIN) path and marginal body contact occurs during the driving shot attempt.

As Fox enters his shooting motion, it is unclear if Gobert (MIN) brushes Fox's elbow on the play. As he continues his shooting motion Gobert (MIN) brings his arm to a vertical position and contest the shot attempt
Sabonis (SAC) legally contests Edwards' (MIN) jump shot attempt. After review, the call of the floor of a made two point basket was confirmed.
Randle (MIN) and Lyles (SAC) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and marginal contact occurs during the rebound.
Ellis (SAC) commits a take foul on Conley (MIN) following the rebound.
